    # intersections of colored horizontal and vertical rails; blank intersections are 0.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # columns 4 mod 7. Infer the marker rows as rows with a color other than rail/background.

    marker_rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v not in (0, 5, 3, 9) for v in grid[r])]
    marker_cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] not in (0, 5, 3, 9) for r in range(h))]
    # Non-rail colors appear at chosen grid intersections; project these onto compressed axes.
    return [[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5, 3, 9) else 0 for c in marker_cols] for r in marker_rows]
